citations.neverFetched: Citations have not been fetched for this document yet. The network is used only when you ask: Refresh looks the document up in OpenAlex (with arXiv and Semantic Scholar as fallbacks) and sends only its identifiers and title, never its text.
citations.refreshHint: Fetches references and citing works from the online sources now.
citations.notFound: No online source knows this work, or it has no DOI, arXiv id or usable title to look it up.
